themes.label: Funerary Inscriptions (Epitaphs)
themes.rationale: The inscription follows the standard Athenian funerary formula, consisting of a personal name and a demotic, identifying the deceased.

themes.label: Tombstone (Gravestone)
themes.rationale: Based on the content and its publication in the Agora XVII corpus (funerary inscriptions), this text was originally inscribed on a gravestone.

themes.label: Fragmentary
themes.rationale: The use of square brackets in the transcription indicates that the right side of the inscription is missing or has been reconstructed.

rationale: This is a typical Athenian funerary inscription from the late 5th century BC. It identifies a man named Teisimachos from the deme of Trikorythos. The text is fragmentary at the ends of the lines, as indicated by the editorial brackets.
